purpose: One version-pinned baseline false-EQ diagnostic, not a new-mechanism experiment or fair speed ranking
input_source: EVIDENCE.json plus exact hashes in local_sources; full three-table DDL

prelaunch_gate.on_failure: Do not launch, queue, or retry; leave unrelated_project untouched

observation: Passive stage/callback/cost logging only; no added callbacks or modified targets/scheduler; track lowering, CSP, Z3, SQLite, CPU and memory separately
control: Static countermodel only in independent backend validation, never supplied to generator; include all source constraints
stop_rules: NEQ: record non-reproduction and close this fixed attempt
EQ with valid independently checked non-equivalence: retain miss, localize implementation versus search cause, no novelty promotion
Unsupported, error, failed control, budget or resource stop: end attribution; no seed/budget expansion
future_implementation_owner: Parent task, high, only if it elects to proceed after reviewing this evidence
